name: Soupapes d'echappement 993 - proxies F1
description: Proxies parametriques non fonctionnels des soupapes d'echappement Carrera et Turbo pour comparer encombrement et masse entre acier generique, Inconel 751 et Ti-6Al-4V sans conclure a une aptitude moteur.

classification.intended_use: Simulation thermique et dynamique preliminaire, masse comparative et controle d'encombrement uniquement

provenance.record_license: MIT for code and record; no third-party geometry redistributed

sources.title: partworks - Dimensions declarees de soupapes d'echappement 993
sources.notes: Carrera 109 x 42,5 x 8 mm ; Turbo 108,9 x 43,5 x 8 mm, sans profil complet ni tolerances.

sources.title: Special Metals - INCONEL alloy 751
sources.notes: Alliage UNS N07751 developpe pour soupapes d'echappement ; barre et fabrication conventionnelle, pas LPBF.

post_processing: stem, seat, groove and tip finishing
coating or hard-facing decision after tribology review

titanium.alloy: Ti-6Al-4V retained only as a deliberately challenged comparison for exhaust service
titanium.galvanic_isolation: seat, guide, retainer and coating compatibility must be reviewed

known_limits: The public dimensions do not define keeper grooves, seat angles and widths, margins, neck radii, coatings or tolerances.
Titanium is not selected for exhaust duty; it remains a comparison requiring measured temperatures and full thermal-fatigue validation.
The generated STLs are fit-check-only and must never be installed in an engine.
